name: make an r statistical runtime available
definition: install or ensure R is present so R scripts for sampling and self-testing can run.
failure_mode: R absence makes every R subprocess step fail

name: mark the reconstruction script as executable and preserve the source listing unchanged
definition: Give the script executable permission while leaving the provided tree listing byte-for-byte intact.
failure_mode: Missing exec bit or altered source listing fails the checks

name: place the built binary on the shell PATH
definition: Install/link the compiled binary so invoking its name from PATH works from any directory.
failure_mode: Binary only runnable by full path, so bare-name PATH invocation fails.

name: preserve the reference model file and simulate with a fresh MuJoCo installation without plugins
definition: Keep the original model unchanged and ensure the tuned file loads under a clean MuJoCo environment with no plugin dependencies.
failure_mode: Reference modified or tuned model depends on plugins/missing assets
